description: This file defines a Spring Boot configuration class WebConfig that sets up CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) policies for the backend server, including allowed origins, headers, methods, and exposing headers.

classes.name: WebConfig
classes.description: A configuration class that defines a CORS filter for handling cross-origin requests in the application.

methods.name: corsFilter
methods.description: Creates and configures a CorsFilter bean with specific CORS policies, including allowed origins, headers, methods, and exposed headers.
